bio: The café at the Palace Holyroodhouse is surrounded by the historic mews courtyard which is full of stunning architecture and avenues of historic significance. This classy royal venue is famous for the occupancy of the British monarch in Scotland and the perfect place to indulge in the great delight of Afternoon Tea. Its traditional aesthetic perfectly encapsulates the Afternoon Tea experience for the customer.  The dining area of The Holyroodhouse has indoor and outdoor seating that supports all whether conditions allowing for enjoyment all year round. The serene plating and presentation of the Afternoon Tea keeps the fine dining experience at the forefront of the service. Enjoy the various exhibitions, performances and lectures that highlight art and historical events whilst indulging in the café’s Afternoon Tea. The Holyroodhouse is the centerpiece to the Holyrood Park which presents beautiful nature walks and trails for customers to explore.  The Afternoon Tea is freshly prepared with many fine dining ingredients adding to the luxurious feeling of the venue. They include fancy twist to the traditional Afternoon tea menu, such as smoked beetroot and salmon gravlax sandwiches as well as orange macarons with white chocolate ganache.  This establishment is right in the heart of Edinburgh with many shops and local venues nearby.  The Edinburgh Waverley is a 13 minute walk away from the Palace cafe and is easy to access to and from The Holyroodhouse.
